🚀 fleetbase | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a comprehensive, modular, and customizable operating system for managing and optimizing logistics and supply chain operations across various industries.
✨ Key Features: • Modular architecture • Logistics and supply chain management • Order management and tracking • Route optimization • Fleet management
📖 Summary: Fleetbase is a modular logistics and supply chain operating system designed to streamline management, planning, optimization, and operational control. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for e-commerce, retail, courier services, field services, and enterprise logistics, with a focus on developers to extend and customize its capabilities.
